schema_sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS Communication (id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY, comm_action NVARCHAR(255), comm_channelid INT, payload NVARCHAR(MAX))
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_action ON Communication(comm_action)
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_comm_channelid ON Communication(comm_channelid)
CREATE NONCLUSTERED INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_payload ON Communication(payload)
generation_sql: INSERT INTO Communication (comm_action, comm_channelid, payload) SELECT TOP ({row_count}) 'Action_' + CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS NVARCHAR), ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID()) % 100), REPLICATE('A', 100) FROM sys.all_objects

tables.name: Communication
tables.purpose: Primary table to simulate the high index count and insert performance issues.
tables.distribution_notes: Uniform distribution for comm_channelid and comm_action, with large payloads to simulate real-world data.

calibration_queries.objective: Verify that the index on comm_channelid is used and the query plan reflects the expected behavior.
